items.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021
items.q: I used to think that every — you remember in the 70s when George Winston’s music was ubiquitous? ... I’d go into a restaurant and they’d have this Chinese water torture drip of sound of George Winston playing

ctx.x: You are a poet also. I enjoyed that description. And one more quote I read from you. I think you were addressing music that bothered you. And you said, “Music which assaults the mind and restricts it with a numbing drone commands the brain not to think and holds thought hostage while it rapes the ear.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Oh boy. I said — that was pretty good. That’s what — I used to think that every — you remember in the 70s when George Winston’s music was ubiquitous?
